partners.mechanism_chain: G6PD (HGNC:4417) —DISRUPTS→ Pentose Phosphate Pathway (GO:0006091); Pentose Phosphate Pathway (GO:0006091) —PRODUCES→ NADPH (CHEBI:17793); NADPH (CHEBI:17793) —INCREASES→ Reduced Glutathione (CHEBI:17676); Reduced Glutathione (CHEBI:17676) —INCREASES→ Redox homeostasis in erythrocytes (GO:0006977); Redox homeostasis in erythrocytes (GO:0006977) —LEADS_TO→ Hemolytic anemia (HP:0001873); HBB (HGNC:4827) —DISRUPTS→ Heinz body formation (HP:0030171); HBA1 (HGNC:4823) —DISRUPTS→ Heinz body formation (HP:0030171); HBA2 (HGNC:4824) —DISRUPTS→ Heinz body formation (HP:0030171); Heinz body formation (HP:0030171) —LEADS_TO→ Heinz body anemia (MONDO:0007705); Redox homeostasis in erythrocytes (GO:0006977) —DISRUPTS→ Heinz body formation (HP:0030171). Variants in G6PD disrupt the pentose phosphate pathway, leading to reduced NADPH production. This impairs the cell's ability to regenerate reduced glutathione, which is crucial for neutralizing reactive oxygen species and maintaining redox homeostasis in erythrocytes. Oxidative stress then leads to hemolytic anemia.
